friendship.en: True friendship grows stronger through time and trust.
friendship.cn: 真正的友谊在时间与信任中愈发坚固。

trust.en: Trust is the most important part of any friendship.
trust.cn: 信任是友谊中最重要的部分。

kind.en: Kind people make the world a much better place.
kind.cn: 善良的人让世界变得更好。

help.en: True friends help each other when things get hard.
help.cn: 真朋友在困难时彼此帮助。

share.en: We share our joys and sorrows with close friends.
share.cn: 我们与好友分享喜怒哀乐。

forgive.en: Sometimes we should forgive and move on together.
forgive.cn: 有时我们要学会原谅，一起向前。

miss.en: I really miss my classmates from primary school.
miss.cn: 我很想念小学的同学们。

forever.en: Some friendships truly last forever, no matter the distance.
forever.cn: 有些友谊跨越距离，真的长存。
